item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00394","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C24","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 plausibly supplied a material diplomatic-letter template for arranging a prominent foreign visitor's trip to the United States. Both letters respond warmly to prior correspondence, express interest in the visit, and defer precise arrangements until officials or representatives can coordinate them. The child adapts C16's general visit-planning machinery to King Leopold, Ambassador Folger, and Admiral Strauss. C24 shares the peaceful-uses-of-atomic-energy subject, and C09 shares correspondence with a prime minister involving technical activity in the United States, but neither provides comparable drafting structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In making initial plans for the visit I would suggest that it might be useful for you to provide Ambassador Folger with a general statement of King Leopold's interests and projected itinerary.","parent_excerpt":"I should appreciate Your Majesty's telling me whether you would find it possible to accept this invitation, after which the precise details of your visit could be worked out by the representatives of our two governments","explanation":"Both establish a two-stage process in which the foreign leader first supplies confirmation or general plans and designated diplomatic representatives then develop the visit details."},{"child_excerpt":"After his arrival in the United States, the King will doubtless wish to establish with Admiral Strauss a precise itinerary to satisfy his interests.","parent_excerpt":"after which the precise details of your visit could be worked out by the representatives of our two governments","explanation":"The distinctive combination of a foreign visit, precise arrangements, and coordination through designated officials is materially parallel."},{"child_excerpt":"You may be assured of our interest in the King's visit and our hope that it will prove to be successful.","parent_excerpt":"The importance of our relationship increases my desire to talk with you and to welcome you here in the United States","explanation":"Both close the substantive discussion by affirming American interest in welcoming the visitor and the success of the proposed visit."}]}
